adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the code reads existing attendees (prisma.booking.findFirst include attendees) and then later does a separate prisma.booking.update with attendees.createMany based on that earlier snapshot. There is no transaction wrapping the read+write in the diff, so concurrent requests could both decide the same email is “unique” and attempt to insert it. Whether this becomes an actual duplicate-row bug depends on DB-level uniqueness constraints on the attendee records, which are not shown in the diff, so the “no unique constraint” part can’t be verified here.
